description: Whether it was rooting out government corruption, combating terrorism, or working to stem the tide of drug abuse, Brian Fitzpatrick has always fought for the security and well-being of our community. Congress needs more proven, independent leaders with a record of getting this done. That’s why I’m supporting Brian Fitzpatrick for Congress.
